title: DOJ settlement over AI-driven job ads
discussion_signal: The post interprets a DOJ settlement involving AI-driven job-ad targeting as a reminder that automated recruitment remains an employer-controlled legal process. It emphasizes auditability, fairness testing, and responsibility for exclusion even when a platform or model produces the targeting.
linked_research_question: How does automated recruitment convert AI-generated language and targeting into enforceable exclusion, compliance work, and institutional responsibility?
limits: The post summarizes a settlement and does not provide the full legal record
Compliance recommendations are not evidence of actual employer practice
One enforcement action cannot estimate prevalence of discriminatory AI hiring
